title: Lab Prefect – Programming for Problem Solving (PPS)
responsibilities: Support the course faculty in laboratory classes and guide junior students through hands-on structured programming.
Teach C and C++ programming through conceptual hints and guided reasoning rather than simply giving away direct answers, fostering independent problem-solving skills.
Explain difficult algorithmic concepts including recursion, pointer arithmetic, memory management, and structured data with beginner-friendly visualizations.
Review student code submissions, assist with debugging, and advise students on competitive programming foundations.

title: Problem Setter & Associate Judging Director – DIU ACM Lab
responsibilities: Create, test, and validate original algorithmic problems for competitive programming contests.
Generate robust test cases (edge cases, boundary limits, corner cases) and write comprehensive solution editorials.
Manage judging workflows and live contest execution for university-wide competitions.
Set problems for the Take-Off Programming Contest (for 2nd-semester students) and Unlock The Algorithm.
Actively cultivate an enthusiastic and rigorous competitive programming culture across the department.

title: Volunteer – National High School Programming Contest (NHSPC) Regional Round
responsibilities: Assisted in on-site operations for the regional round of the National High School Programming Contest.
Supported participating school and college students with lab setup, contest platform navigation, and problem logistics.
Helped foster interest in computing and problem-solving among young students in Bangladesh.

title: Volunteer – ICPC 2024 Dhaka Regional Contest
responsibilities: Supported the organizing committee in hosting the International Collegiate Programming Contest Dhaka Regional.
Managed on-site contest floor operations, team workstations, and judging logistics for university teams across Bangladesh.
